svg.title: Healthcare CRM architecture
svg.desc: A staff browser loads a React app from Cloudflare, signs in with Cognito, and calls API Gateway. API Gateway invokes a Lambda function that reads and writes a DynamoDB data table and an audit table, both encrypted with a KMS key. GitHub Actions deploys to Cloudflare and AWS. Moving dots show data flowing between the services.
svg.text: Browser loads the React app from Cloudflare
Sign in with password and authenticator code
API call carrying the Cognito ID token
API Gateway checks the token, then runs Lambda
Lambda reads and writes patients, notes, appointments
Lambda writes an audit record for every request
Function logs, encrypted with the same key
Moving dots: blue = requests, green = audit records and logs, amber = deployments, purple = encryption. Dashed arrows: the KMS key encrypts both tables.
AWS and Cloudflare logos are trademarks of their owners, used only to identify the services.
